plugin.name: Chronicle Panel Examples
plugin.description: Reference library containing multiple trusted Chronicle custom panels.

panels.name: Example: Damage Summary
panels.description: Aggregates player and pet damage through Chronicle replay in a plugin-owned worker.

panels.name: Example: Gear Rarity
panels.description: Counts every player's equipped items by rarity with sortable columns.

panels.name: Example: Replay Casts
panels.description: Shows casts up to Chronicle's current replay timestamp.
